outlets.name: Guide MICHELIN Deutschland
outlets.credible: Institutional fine-dining authority; a lone Michelin distinction (star, Bib Gourmand, or 'Selected/good cooking' plate) satisfies the source bar. Used here for Wettsteins (Langerwehe) and Genießer Wirtshaus (Simmerath).

outlets.name: Der Feinschmecker
outlets.credible: Established German gourmet magazine/guide with editorial ratings; ranks the Maassen coffee roastery among Germany's best. German-language.

outlets.name: Eifel Tourismus (eifel.info / eifel.de)
outlets.credible: Official regional tourism board for the Eifel (Eifel Tourismus GmbH); curated POI + gastronomy database, German-language. (eifel.info and eifel.de are its two portals.)

outlets.name: Rureifel-Tourismus e.V.
outlets.credible: Official DMO for the Rureifel/Nordeifel (Heimbach, Nideggen, Simmerath); the local authority on this area's restaurants. German-language.

outlets.name: Eifelsteig (offizieller Wanderweg)
outlets.credible: Official Eifelsteig premium-trail site run by Eifel Tourismus; curated Gastgeber/POIs along the Aachen–Trier route.

outlets.name: Tourismus NRW (Dein NRW / entdecke.dein-nrw.de)
outlets.credible: Official state tourism marketing organisation for North Rhine-Westphalia; editorial POI + Gastro database. German-language.

outlets.name: Eifel-Tour (eifel-tour.de)
outlets.credible: German-language regional Eifel travel portal with curated Gastro/POI entries; used as a second corroborating regional source, not a user-review aggregator.

outlets.name: de-eifel.de
outlets.credible: German-language regional Eifel hotel/gastronomy portal with editorial venue descriptions; corroborating regional source.

outlets.name: Roetgen-Touristik
outlets.credible: Official municipal tourism office of Roetgen (the Eifel gateway community); curated local gastronomy listings. German-language.

outlets.name: Aachener Zeitung / Aachener Nachrichten
outlets.credible: Newspaper of record for Aachen and its StädteRegion incl. the Eifel and Kreis Düren; bylined local editorial and Genuss features. German-language.

outlets.name: Top Magazin Aachen (top-aachen.de)
outlets.credible: Established regional lifestyle/city magazine for Aachen and the StädteRegion with editorial dining features. German-language.

outlets.name: Schlemmerregion Aachen-Eifel-Euregio
outlets.credible: German-language regional restaurant/café directory for the Aachen-Eifel-Euregio with curated venue entries (not a Yelp/TripAdvisor user-rating aggregator); used only as a second corroborating source alongside an official tourism board.
